title: The Longest Night (NPO & The Failed Angioplasty)
summary: Admitted to the inpatient cardiac step-down unit at New River Valley Medical Center in Christiansburg and placed on strict NPO status, Jordan faces a terrifying fork in the road: a afternoon balloon angioplasty in the Cath Lab, or open-heart bypass surgery (CABG) in Roanoke if the balloon fails. After Mark shares the unvarnished truth about his uncle's quintuple bypass, Zoë logs a permanent Family Vow that Jordan will never return to Hampton Roads, and Henry, Garrett, and Kelsey lock down campus coverage, Jordan hugs his family at the red line and goes under anesthesia—only to wake to the devastating news that the 99% rock-hard calcified blockage caused the angioplasty to fail and nearly cost him his life on the table, trapping him and his family in a grueling 48-hour NPO vigil before a critical care transfer to Star City General in Roanoke is forced onto two-lane U.S. Route 11 by an I-81 pileup.
